mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin of the respective individual

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, officers, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK HMT sanctions list, EU Consolidated List, and the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission's prohibited person registers. Enhanced due diligence applies to domestic and foreign PEPs, their family members, and close associates, requiring source-of-wealth documentation and approval from the AML/CFT compliance officer. Irremediable positive hits cause mandatory rejection of onboarding.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry Online Portal – https://www.vfsc.vu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Business names must use Latin script; English and French are acceptable, and Bislama names are permitted after transliteration into Latin characters. The name must include a legally distinct suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd', or an approved French equivalent. No Chinese-character transliteration or local script requirement exists; names intended for global digital distribution must be read as Latin-alphabet text.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the VFSC rejects a proposed name, the applicant, through a VFSC-licensed registered agent, has 21 days to file a written appeal with the Registrar. The appeal must state the legal grounds for superiority over the objection, propose necessary amendments, and pay the applicable administrative fee. If the Registrar confirms rejection, the applicant may apply to the Vanuatu Supreme Court for judicial review within 30 days of the refusal, under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: No. A physical registered office in Vanuatu, located at the address of a VFSC-licensed registered agent, is mandatory for all International Companies. Virtual offices cannot replace the statutory registered office. Operationally, the digital micro-drama production, streaming, and distribution business may be managed entirely from outside Vanuatu, but the registered agent and physical legal address must remain domestically effective.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-moderate. For a non-licensed digital content distribution vehicle with no statutory license requirement, the annual probability of an unannounced VFSC physical inspection is estimated at less than 8%, rising to near-certainty only upon adverse media, sanctions hits, or a substantive AML/CFT investigation trigger.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Cap 222), as amended, ss. 4-8 (incorporation), s. 10 (registered office and registered agent), s. 12 (constitution), and ss. 19-20 (directors and officers), together with VFSC Registration Circulars.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies and Trusts Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association, together with the Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-01) and the registered agent's Statutory Declaration of Compliance.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up share capital; no escrow deposit required. Shares may be issued in any currency and paid for in cash, in-kind assets, or services.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers' subscription to shares set forth in the Memorandum and Articles be accepted, and the Board hereby approves the allotment and issuance of 1,000 ordinary shares at par; FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company be established at the address of Nevel Burrows Lawyers, Port Vila, Vanuatu, as designated in the registered agent agreement; FURTHER RESOLVED, that the following Officers be appointed: Director, President, Secretary, and Treasurer, each to hold office until the next annual general meeting, with authority to execute banking instruments, open and operate accounts, and file all statutory returns with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC online name reservation portal – International Companies and Trusts Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the VFSC e-portal, submit a name reservation request ensuring the proposed name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company, attach the required dossiers in PDF format and await name approval.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of beneficial owner / subscriber
Short description of intended business (ISIC 5911: production and global distribution of vertical micro-dramas)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as undesirable or confusingly similar, file a revised name with the Registry within five working days; the first resubmission carries no additional VFSC fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of constitution instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-accredited licensed registered agent and Vanuatu notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed registered agent, prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association, execute the documents before a notary, and obtain written consents from the registered agent and initial directors.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as registered agent
Passport copies and proof of residential address of each subscriber/director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarial attestation is challenged, re-execute before a qualified notary, affix certified English translations where necessary, and file a supplementary declaration with the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC – International Companies and Trusts Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed constitution, Form IC-01, the registered agent's Statutory Declaration of Compliance, and proof of payment of the USD 350 government fee through the registered agent's secure filing platform.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-01)
Statutory Declaration of Compliance by the registered agent
Payment receipt / proof of state fee transfer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues an insufficiency or query notice, respond within five business days with corrected instruments or additional exhibits; upon cure, the original submission date is preserved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC – International Companies and Trusts Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon validation of the filing, the Registrar stamps the constitution, allocates a registration number, enters the company in the International Companies Register, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation to the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Stamped Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains a typographical or data entry error, submit a correction request with the defective certificate and a certified copy; the Registry reissues at a nominal correction fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board meeting and officer appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting, adopt the first board resolution approving share allotment, adopt the registered office address in Port Vila, appoint the Director, President, Secretary, and Treasurer, and execute banking account opening instructions with a licensed Vanuatu bank.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as officer forms
Registered office address confirmation from the licensed agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an officer appointment is invalidated for want of quorum or consent, record a restated resolution and re-file the executed consents with the registered agent within five working days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – no Vanuatu industrial licensing board governs digital content production or distribution. Registration as an International Company under the International Companies Act (Cap 222) is the sole corporate authorisation; no separate industry operating license is required.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – no formal operating or manufacturing permit is required for non-resident digital short-drama production and global distribution conducted through Vanuatu.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no physical manufacturing facility in Vanuatu; service-based digital business triggers no EIA report or registration under the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations. Any temporary location filming inside a protected area would require a separate DEPC permit.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for office-only operations. If a temporary production studio is established in Vanuatu, it must comply with municipal wastewater discharge limits under the Vanuatu Water and Waste Management Act and applicable solid waste handling rules; VOC emissions from digital production are negligible and no industrial emission standards apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire safety certificate, structural load inspection, or workplace occupation clearance is required for a purely digital platform. If a physical office or studio in Port Vila is leased, obtain a standard occupancy permit and fire safety inspection from the Port Vila Municipal Council; no civil defense permit applies.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), operating under the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official tax administration portal: https://www.vu.customs/; VAT registration administered directly by the VRC VAT Unit in Port Vila.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A VU_IC incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is not automatically issued a Vanuatu tax identification number. For the tax-exempt IC that wishes to claim VAT zero-rating on exported digital services or to open a local revenue trail, the following procedure applies: (i) submit VRC Form VAT-01 (Application for Registration) together with a certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); (ii) submit the registered agent certificate, the registered office address, list of directors/shareholders, and a local or foreign payment processor/bank confirmation; (iii) estimate taxable turnover to demonstrate either mandatory registration (taxable turnover in the observation period exceeds VUV 5,000,000 per annum) or voluntary registration; (iv) upon approval, VRC issues a VAT registration certificate with a unique TIN, normally within 5–10 business days. Non-resident ownership raises no restrictions; a foreign-domiciled director is allowed, but a local licensed agent must be maintained for the IC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: The VU_IC is not a pass-through entity and is not subject to Vanuatu entity-level income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, profits tax, or business licence tax, by virtue of sections 2, 3, and 7 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222]. This exemption is statutory rather than election-based. The only national indirect tax exposure is VAT under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 250], and it applies only to taxable supplies made in or imported into Vanuatu. The VU_IC's global revenues from a short-drama streaming app (Apple IAP, Google Play, Stripe) sourced entirely from non-resident subscribers are, as an international company, outside the scope of Vanuatu income taxation and qualify for VAT zero-rating as exported services.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no check-the-box election and no hybrid mismatch election. The sole statutory elections relevant to a VU_IC are: (i) voluntary VAT registration under section 7 of the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 250], elected by an exporter to recover input VAT and to legitimise zero-rated invoices issued to non-resident customers; and (ii) an IC's binding election under section 14 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222] to convert to a domestic company under the Companies Act [Cap 191], which irrevocably removes the tax-exempt status and subjects the entity to full domestic income tax and business licence obligations. No other tax classification elections are available under Vanuatu law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 250], a unitary national consumption tax of the GST family; no separate provincial/local sales tax exists.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 of taxable supplies in any 12-month period (approx. USD 42,000 at prevailing official exchange rate); mandatory registration threshold; exporters of zero-rated supplies may register voluntarily from the first Vatu of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing telemetry, API integration, or digital stamping mandate is currently enforced in Vanuatu. The VRC requires, however, that every VAT-registered supplier issues a sequentially numbered VAT invoice containing the supplier's name, address and TIN, the recipient's name/address/TIN where available, a unique invoice number and date, a description of supplies, the value exclusive of VAT, the VAT amount at 15%, and the invoice total. Invoices may be issued electronically, but such e-invoices are not subject to pre-clearance or live countersignature by VRC. The taxpayer must retain the invoice issue log and make it available to VRC upon inspection, with the record retention window set at a minimum of 7 years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under section 5(2) of the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 250] to (a) supplies of goods physically exported from Vanuatu, and (b) supplies of services performed for or directly enjoyed by a person who belongs in a country outside Vanuatu. For the VU_IC's vertical micro-drama streaming app, each supply of digital subscription, pay-per-view micro-drama, or advertisement-based streaming service sold through Apple IAP, Google Play Billing, or Stripe to an end-user located outside Vanuatu must satisfy the 'direct export of services' test: the place of consumption is the subscriber's foreign country, the contract is with a non-resident subscriber or app-store aggregator, the digital content is delivered electronically to the foreign user, and the invoice identifies the non-resident buyer. Supplies which bleed into the domestic Vanuatu market (e.g., an in-app sale to a customer physically present in Vanuatu) are taxable at 15%, and revenue allocation is based on the app store's country-of-account data at the time of purchase.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (VRC-approved declaration with e-tracking number, showing HS code item, quantity, exporter TIN, destination country)
Bill of Lading (Ocean) or Airway Bill (air), plus any Master/Sub-House bill where a freight consolidator is used
Commercial Invoice and Packing List duly signed by the IC's registered agent or director
Proof of actual receipt of foreign currency (Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a Vanuatu or offshore bank, or a PayPal/Stripe settlement statement evidencing the five international wire rails)
Digital distribution settlement report from the app store platform (weekly/monthly statement of sales by country identifying the non-resident end customers)
Service contract or end-user licence agreement proving the place of reception lies outside Vanuatu
Copy of the VU_IC's VAT registration certificate and VFSC Certificate of Incorporation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Although Vanuatu imposes no exchange controls, a 180-calendar-day outward remittance/receipt settlement window is the outer substantiation period benchmark used by VRC to support a zero-rating claim for exported services; if the corresponding foreign-currency settlement is not received within the 180-day window, the VRC may issue an assessment treating the supply as taxable at 15%. Penalties for fraudulent or unsupported zero-ratings include a 100% penalty on the VAT understated, monthly compounding interest at statutory rates, administrative fines of up to VUV 1,000,000, imprisonment of the responsible director for tax fraud under the Value Added Tax Act, forfeiture of the importer's/ exporter's goods, and, in the case of a VU_IC, a strike-off of the company by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and the loss of the International Companies Act tax exemption. VRC audits carry a 7-year look-back period; therefore, complete documentary evidence (contracts, invoices, aggregated app-store records, bank/Stripe settlement statements, and customs or e-export manifests for physical media) must be retained for no less than 8 years after the export transaction.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 41], the Exchange Control Regulations, and the International Banking Act [Cap 269]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) administers International Company registration and AML/CFT supervision of banks and registered agents.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains a liberal exchange-control regime with current-account convertibility effectively unrestricted. The VUV is the legal tender and the RBV publishes daily reference rates, but non-resident-owned International Companies (ICs) that operate entirely in foreign currency are not subject to prior RBV exchange-control approval for bona fide trade and capital transactions. Capital-account inflows (shareholder equity injections, shareholder loans) are freely permitted for non-resident ICs provided the IC does not borrow from Vanuatu residents; an Authorised Dealer must record the transaction for statistical purposes. Profit remittance and dividend distribution are unrestricted and not subject to Vanuatu income tax or withholding tax under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], although the paying bank will require a VFSC certificate of good standing, filed annual returns, and a written remittance instruction. For a micro-drama streaming IC (ISIC 5911), treasury operations should be concentrated in USD/EUR to minimise VUV conversion friction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no mandatory surrender or forced conversion of export proceeds. The statutory surrender ratio is zero percent; exporters and non-resident ICs may retain 100% of receipts from digital exports (streaming subscriptions, in-app purchases, advertising revenue, content licensing) in any convertible currency or in VUV-denominated accounts. The only obligation is that Authorised Dealers submit monthly cross-border transaction reports to the RBV under the Exchange Control Regulations for balance-of-payments statistics. VUV conversion of export proceeds, if desired, may be executed at commercial bank rates with a statement of the underlying trade.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of the South Pacific (Vanuatu) Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-currency Operational Account (USD/EUR/AUD/VUV) with capital escrow and term deposit sub-accounts
Corporate Transaction Account (USD/EUR/VUV) with FX line and term escrow facilities
Corporate Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account (VUV and convertible foreign currency)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for direct fintech EMI onboarding in Vanuatu. The jurisdiction has no electronic money institution licensing regime, no fintech passporting framework, and the Currency Exchange Act [Cap 137] restricts unlicensed money-exchange activity. Major global EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer) do not support Vanuatu-incorporated companies as primary onboarding clients, and Stripe does not list Vanuatu as a supported settlement country. A legally viable structure is to use a licensed foreign merchant-of-record or a Hong Kong/Singapore/Delaware subsidiary of the Vanuatu IC for Apple IAP, Google Play Billing, and Stripe settlement, with subsequent intercompany licence-fee remittance to the IC. The non-resident IC may lawfully hold accounts with reputable foreign EMIs only for collection purposes, provided the EMI holds a valid money-services licence in its host jurisdiction and does not solicit business from Vanuatu residents.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical in-branch interview is the de facto standard for first onboarding of a new Vanuatu International Company with non-resident ultimate beneficial owners. Under the RBV AML/CFT Rules, Authorised Dealers must conduct face-to-face or equivalent CDD; in practice BSP, BRED, and NBV require at least one authorised director or a senior compliance officer of the licensed registered agent to attend a Port Vila or Luganville branch interview with original identification documents. Remote opening is possible only where the UBOs are existing regulated clients of the same banking group and the interview is supplemented by apostilled certified documents, a banker's reference, and video-verification technology; otherwise physical attendance is effectively mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly formed International Company with no consolidated financial history requesting immediate high-volume multi-currency facilities for micro-drama distribution.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit a certified VFSC trade register extract, Registered Agent's Certificate of Incumbency, UBO ownership chart, management accounts from inception, 12-month cash-flow forecast, signed Apple IAP and Google Play Billing payout statements, and the content intellectual-property licence register.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner layers in multiple low-tax zones (BVI/Seychelles trusts) creating opaque control of the streaming entity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a full corporates-ownership chart, trust deed summary, certified UBO register from the registered agent, apostilled passports and utility bills for each natural person, and an independent legal opinion confirming the effective control analysis under Vanuatu International Companies law.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid inbound equity injection followed by outbound payments to production houses and talent in transaction-heavy jurisdictions (CN, THB, PHP) without documented service contracts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver executed production service agreements, per-episode cost breakdowns, talent and IP assignment agreements, milestone invoices, SWIFT purpose-code narratives, and monthly dubbing/post-production invoices; maintain a fully documented invoicing chain with no cash or crypto leg.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business description mismatch: bank occupational profile conflicts with payment rails that show inflow from Apple/Google app stores and ad networks rather than traditional media distributors.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Present the ISIC 5911 / NAICS 512110 line-of-business description, App Store and Google Play developer console URLs, merchant-of-record statements, monthly ad-network reports, and a treasury flow diagram confirming the Vanuatu IC is the commercial principal, not a pass-through shell.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing protocol: shareholders transmit SWIFT MT103 wires to the IC's BSP, BRED, or NBV account with the beneficiary name exactly matching the VFSC-registered entity, using narrative 'EQUITY SUBSCRIPTION VU_IC / ISIC 5911 SHARE ALLOTMENT'. The instruction must reference the bank's SWIFT BIC and the IC's segregated VUV or USD clearing account. The corporate file must contain a board resolution approving the share allotment, issued share certificates, and a completed exchange-control statistical record filed through the Authorised Dealer. For trade receipts originating from app stores and digital platforms, the platform payout must name the legal entity and be matched against gateway settlement reports; the recommended statistical purpose code is '510030 – digital content services revenue'. For liquidity efficiency, request the bank's USD/EUR nostro clearing account to avoid any VUV conversion and the associated RBV revaluation spread.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound treasury rails include: (1) SWIFT MT103 for individual cross-border payments such as Chinese production studios, Southeast Asian talent agencies, cloud hosting and transcoding services; (2) SWIFT MT101 customer-payment-initiation messages for batch payroll and royalty runs; (3) irrevocable confirmed Commercial Letters of Credit (MT700/MT750 issuance) for high-value backend distribution buyouts where the beneficiary requires bank-undertaking certainty; and (4) platform clearing rails from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing arriving via their US/EU acquiring banks in monthly settlement cycles, then reconciled against gateway reports. Treasury convention: route all disbursements through segregated USD, EUR, and CNY accounts, preserve a 45-day liquidity buffer for anticipated royalty outgo, and include clear payment-purposes narratives inside every MT103 to satisfy Authorised Dealer and correspondent-bank monitoring. Use SWIFT gpi tracking for time-critical talent and production payments; bank charges are booked as FX and clearing commissions.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forwards: USD/VUV, USD/CNH, USD/THB, and USD/EUR forward contracts with tenors up to 12 months, executed via BSP or BRED Treasury under an ISDA-type master confirmation.
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs): USD/VUV NDFs referencing the RBV official daily reference rate, and USD/CNH NDFs to hedge offshore RMB production costs facing the Vanuatu IC.

Cross-Currency Swaps: USD/VUV and USD/EUR cross-currency interest-rate and principal swaps under an ISDA master agreement for long-dated content-licence asset positions and to convert floating USD gatekeeper revenue into fixed-rate expense obligations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Renewal of International Company License
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month immediately following each anniversary of the date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 10% per month or part of a month on the unpaid annual fee; persistent non-payment for six months triggers administrative strike-off and forfeiture of company assets to the Republic; reinstatement requires a VFSC discretionary restoration order and settlement of all arrears, penalties, and reinstatement fees

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership and AML/CFT Declaration to Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent licensed by VFSC (maintains confidential UBO file)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the incorporation anniversary renewal date; immediate re-confirmation required upon any share transfer, allotment, or change of director
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-submission obliges the registered agent to report the default to VFSC and may block annual license renewal; continued default constitutes an offence under the AML/CFT Act subject to fines of up to USD 10,000 and potential administrative strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a Vanuatu International Company; fully exempt from statutory audit and financial statement filing irrespective of revenue, assets, or shareholder count; a voluntary audit may only be triggered by a written requisition from members holding 10% or more of voting shares or by a requirement inserted into the company's articles of association
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory framework under the International Companies Act; the company must keep accounting records sufficient to explain transactions and enable the financial position to be determined with reasonable accuracy; if financial statements are voluntarily prepared, IFRS or US GAAP is commonly adopted for internal management, IP financing, and distributor due diligence purposes

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no publicly searchable central UBO register; the registered agent must obtain a signed annual declaration of beneficial ownership from each director and member and retain supporting KYC documentation for a minimum of five years; any share transfer, allotment, or change of significant control (25% or more) requires a fresh UBO declaration and an updated register of members within 30 days of the underlying change
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (resolutions of members and directors)
Register of Beneficial Owners (held by registered agent at registered office in Port Vila)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required by statute; voluntary certified audit USD 2,500 - 5,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax on any company, including International Companies (ICs), under the Income Tax Act [Cap 181]; ICs enjoy an absolute statutory exemption confirmed by the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The International Company (IC) is a statutory tax-exempt vehicle: zero tax on worldwide profits, zero capital gains tax, zero stamp duty on share transfers, zero payroll tax for non-resident employees, and zero social security contributions. No tax returns are required for income; the only fiscal cost is the annual VFSC registration fee and the registered agent's professional fee. The IC may hold IP (short-drama content library, streaming software) and stream subscription revenue through Apple IAP, Google Play Billing, and Stripe without any Vanuatu tax incidence, provided it does not carry on domestic business with Vanuatu residents.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC International Company Annual Return — filed electronically through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online registry portal or via the licensed registered agent's portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return and annual insurance fee are due on the anniversary of incorporation of the IC. A grace period of 60 days applies; failure to file and pay within 60 days triggers a late penalty of 20% of the annual fee; failure within 90 days leads to automatic strike-off from the VFSC register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1: Registered Name and VFSC Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The exact legal name of the International Company and the unique VFSC file number assigned at incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident beneficial owner must ensure the name matches the Certificate of Incorporation; any change of name requires prior VFSC approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2: Registered Office Address in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The physical street address of the registered office in Port Vila, which must be the office of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident IC cannot maintain its own physical office in Vanuatu for IC status; the registered agent's address is mandatory and must be listed verbatim.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3: Registered Agent Name and License Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The corporate identity and VFSC license number of the appointed registered agent, who must co-sign the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent is the responsible statutory filer; non-resident directors should proactively deliver confirmation of beneficial ownership and directors' details to the agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4: Directors' Full Legal Names and Residential Addresses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Every director's full legal name, nationality, residential address, and date of appointment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors must provide passport copies and proof of residential address; use legal names, never pseudonyms or alternative names.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5: Shareholders / Members and Shareholding Schedule
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of all members, the class and number of shares held, and the percentage ownership interest.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee shareholder arrangements are permitted but must be disclosed to the registered agent; beneficial ownership information is held by the agent for AML compliance and is not publicly indexed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6: Authorised and Issued Share Capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The authorised share capital and the number of issued shares, including par value per class.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum paid-up capital is required; a single issued share is sufficient. Non-residents may capitalize the IC with content IP or intercompany receivables without Vanuatu tax consequences.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7: Declaration of Non-Carrying-On-Business in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: A statutory declaration that the IC has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents, owns no real estate in Vanuatu, and does not engage in domestic banking or insurance activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The short-drama streaming app must categorically exclude Vanuatu residents from its user base and must not enter into Vanuatu-facing revenue contracts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8: Signature of Director or Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The return must be signed and dated by a director or the registered agent, certifying the truth and completeness of the information.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remote digital signature by a non-resident director is accepted; transmitting signed pages to the agent satisfies VFSC electronic lodgement.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or late payment of the annual fee: 20% surcharge after 60 days from the incorporation anniversary; automatic administrative strike-off after a further 90-day default. A struck-off IC's assets are forfeited to the Crown of Vanuatu; reinstatement requires payment of all outstanding fees, penalties, and a reinstatement fee. Making a false statement in the annual return is an offence punishable by a fine of up to VT 500,000 and, on continuing default, a further daily penalty.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu VAT Return (Form 100) — filed electronically via the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC) taxpayer portal, or in paper form.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly; quarterly for approved small businesses with annual taxable turnover below the VAT registration threshold.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Monthly returns are due on or before the 15th day of the month following the end of the taxable period; quarterly returns are due on or before the 15th day of the month following the end of the quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The VAT registration number assigned by the VRC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC engaged exclusively in offshore short-drama distribution is not required to register for VAT because it makes no taxable supplies in Vanuatu. If the IC is registered (e.g., for app sales to Vanuatu residents), it must display the TIN on invoices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part B: Output VAT / Taxable Supplies
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of taxable supplies made during the period at the 12.5% VAT rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs should report only supplies made to Vanuatu customers; zero-resource foreign subscriptions, Apple IAP and Google Play Billing proceeds are outside Vanuatu VAT scope.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part C: Input VAT / Creditable Purchases
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of eligible input tax on Vanuatu business purchases (e.g., local advertising, studio services) incurred directly for taxable supplies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Input VAT is recoverable only if the IC holds valid Vanuatu tax invoices and the input relates to a Vanuatu taxable supply; offshore content production costs in foreign jurisdictions are not creditable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part D: Net VAT Payable or Refundable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The arithmetic difference between output and input VAT, remitted to the VRC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For the offshore IC, net VAT will be zero because no Vanuatu taxable supplies exist; the IC should still keep its global revenue records available to prove exclusion from the VAT net.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty equal to 25% of the net VAT payable; late payment attracts a further 25% surcharge plus daily interest at 2% per month or part thereof. Failure to register when required is an offence carrying a fine of up to 100% of the tax evaded and potential prosecution of the directors.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax, no branch profit remittance tax, and no exit capital gains tax on distributions from an International Company, regardless of the residence of the recipient.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu is not a party to any comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA); it maintains only Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) with Australia, New Zealand, and other Pacific and European partners. Because Vanuatu law imposes no withholding tax, no treaty relief application or Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) is required to repatriate profits. Where a foreign shareholder's home jurisdiction requires proof of the IC's tax status, the VFSC can issue a Certificate of Good Standing and the registered agent can provide a Certificate of Incorporation and a certified copy of the shareholder register; the shareholder may then claim a foreign tax credit in its home state on the basis of the IC's effective 0% Vanuatu tax burden. A foreign payer (e.g., an App Store operator) that demands a tax residence certificate should be instructed that Vanuatu ICs are not tax residents for income tax purposes; the certificate of incorporation and the IC Act exemption provision (Section 2 of the International Companies Act) are the operative legal instruments.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% on royalties, 0% on interest, 0% on technical service fees. Vanuatu has no domestic withholding tax law and no DTA network, so no treaty-reduced rate applies; payments of content licensing royalties (short-drama IP), intercompany interest, and streaming platform commissions or fees to non-residents may be made free of any Vanuatu tax. The IC should nonetheless obtain full documentation of the underlying payment flow (contracts, invoices, platform statements) to satisfy foreign authorities that the payments are genuine and commercially commensurate.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu has not enacted transfer pricing legislation, and International Companies are exempt from all direct taxes; therefore no Local File or Master File thresholds exist. The statutory threshold under domestic law is nil (0 VUV). Nevertheless, group documentation should still be maintained to protect against foreign anti-avoidance rules (CFC, PFIC, double dip) applicable in the shareholders' home countries.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not apply modern Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) in the style of the UAE or BVI. The International Companies Act mandates passive non-domestic status rather than an economic substance test: the IC must not carry on business with Vanuatu residents, must not own land in Vanuatu, and must maintain its registered office and agent in Port Vila. To prevent the IC from falling within the EU/OECD list of non-cooperative jurisdictions, the Vanuatu government and VFSC expect ICs to demonstrate genuine commercial purpose: board resolutions, director appointments, record keeping, and an active digital operation. For the vertical micro-drama business, the IC should hold the global content licence rights and streaming agreements, maintain written records of subscription pricing, and show that Apple IAP, Google Play Billing, and Stripe payment flows correspond to the group's operating reality.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Abuse / False Exemption Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Vanuatu International Company as a pure invoice-or shell entity with no real commercial record, or using the exempt IC to disguise a domestic Vanuatu business (e.g., selling short-drama subscriptions to Vanuatu residents, renting local office space, employing Vanuatu residents without VAT/payroll compliance).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The IC is liable to forfeit its exempt status and be struck off the VFSC register; all assets may be forfeited to the Crown of Vanuatu. A false declaration in the annual return carries a fine of up to VT 500,000 plus continuing daily penalties of VT 10,000; the IC may also retroactively become liable to Vanuatu tax, including VAT at 12.5% and any applicable customs duties, with penalties of up to double the evaded tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly submit a false declaration are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution of any distributions made while the IC was not validly in existence; they may be disqualified from acting as directors in Vanuatu for up to 5 years and are subject to criminal prosecution with imprisonment of up to 2 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion in Foreign Markets via Vanuatu Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring business so that the Vanuatu IC is used to conceal taxable income in a shareholder's home jurisdiction (e.g., funneling short-drama streaming profits to evade Chinese, Australian, or other CIT or IIT), or manufacturing artificial intercompany deductions against a foreign affiliate without economic substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: While Vanuatu imposes no domestic sanction for foreign tax avoidance, Vanuatu is an AEOI signatory and will exchange beneficial ownership and financial account information on request; the IC can be struck off if the foreign regulatory investigations reveal that the Vanuatu entity was used as a sham. VFSC regulatory action may impose monetary fines up to VT 1,000,000 for breaching the International Companies Act. Practically, the foreign jurisdiction will assess the true taxpayer with back taxes, interest, and penalties, plus potential criminal referral.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Foreign directors are exposed to personal criminal indictment in the shareholder's home jurisdiction, including travel bans, extradition requests, and imprisonment; Vanuatu courts will assist civil recovery where the veil is pierced because the IC is a mere instrumentality used to commit fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC's Stripe, Apple IAP, or Google Play Billing accounts to launder proceeds from fraudulent short-drama scams, fake subscription schemes, or criminal payments; deliberately concealing beneficial ownership; or accepting funds in cash or through non-compliant e-wallets without the know-your-customer (KYC) evidence of end users.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Vanuatu Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act (as amended), a corporate entity that commits an AML offence is liable to a fine of up to VT 30,000,000; freezing orders, forfeiture of all app revenue, and dissolution of the IC may follow. The licensed registered agent and any Vanuatu payment intermediary will be independently penalised for failures in suspicious transaction reporting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners who direct or profit from AML activity face personal fines of up to VT 300,000 and imprisonment of up to 10 years; the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit may issue travel bans and asset restraint orders; civil forfeiture is recoverable against the individual's worldwide assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Concealment of Beneficial Ownership / Registered Agent Misconduct
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Providing false or incomplete beneficial ownership information to the VFSC-registered agent, refusing to disclose ultimate shareholders, or using a nominee without executing a declaration of trust — specifically to evade regulatory scrutiny of the short-drama streaming revenue flow.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The registered agent is required to terminate its relationship with the IC and make a suspicious activity report to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit; the IC is subject to a penalty of VT 500,000 and can be compulsorily struck off. The agent may also resign, which immediately exposes the IC to deregistration if no substitute agent is appointed within 30 days.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director who participated in the concealment is personally liable to civil restitution and to disqualification; repeat violations are treated as criminal fraud, attracting imprisonment up to 2 years and mandatory restitution of all funds distributed to shareholders during the concealment period.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Financial Records / Insolvent Distributions (Wrongful Trading)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying dividends or management fees to shareholders while the IC is technically insolvent, or destroying, concealing, or fabricating revenue reports and subscription records to inflate distributable profits for the vertical micro-drama business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu courts apply common law principles of fraudulent and wrongful trading. The court may order the repayment of all unlawful dividends plus interest, make a declaration that the directors are personally liable for the company's debts, and wind up the IC. The VFSC may fine the company up to VT 1,000,000 for failure to keep proper accounting records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal civil liability for the full amount of unlawful distributions, a compensation order in favour of creditors, travel prohibition pending the hearing, and, where dishonesty is proven, criminal prosecution with imprisonment up to 3 years and a personal fine up to VT 500,000.
